controles.affirmation: Passif amiante en aggravation continue ; c'est un passif recurrent et croissant, et le 10-Q du 21 juillet 2026 confirme que ces poursuites et procedures reglementaires restent actives (preuve citee : 'lawsuits, principally in the United States, and regulatory proceedings worldwide')
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, section dediee 'Asbestos-Related Product Liability and Insurance Receivable' : 'We have 3,513 pending asbestos lawsuits as of June 30, 2026. The amount accrued for pending and future claims was $ 294 million as of June 30, 2026... The amount accrued for pending and future claims was $ 317 million as of December 31, 2025... Our undiscounted product liability was $ 375 million and $ 398 million as of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. There have been no significant developments to the information presented in our 2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K with respect to litigation or commitments and contingencies.' La phrase citee par l'ATT provient d'un paragraphe generique distinct, qui ne parle pas d'amiante et se poursuit ainsi : '...we believe that our insurance coverage and our defense, and ultimate resolution of pending and reasonably anticipated claims will not have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations or financial condition.'
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q du 21 juillet 2026 ne confirme pas une aggravation : le passif amiante provisionne RECULE, de 317 M$ au 31 decembre 2025 a 294 M$ au 30 juin 2026 (-7%), et de 398 a 375 M$ en non actualise, avec la mention explicite qu'il n'y a eu aucun developpement significatif. Remplacer le titre 'Passif amiante en aggravation continue' par une formulation bornee a 2025 : 'Choc amiante de 103 M$ en 2025, sans confirmation d'aggravation au premier semestre 2026'. Remplacer la citation generique tronquee par le passage amiante specifique du 10-Q, sans couper la seconde moitie de la phrase source.

controles.affirmation: Ces notations (S&P BBB- et Moody's Baa1) restent juste au-dessus du seuil investment grade
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, tableau Debt Ratings au 31 decembre 2025 : Long-term debt S&P 'BBB-', Moody's 'Baa1', Outlook 'Negative' / 'Negative'. Meme section : 'During the first quarter of 2026, we also received ratings from Fitch Ratings. Fitch assigned our long-term and senior unsecured notes a rating of BBB- with a stable outlook.'
controles.correction_proposee: Seul S&P (BBB-) est au dernier cran de l'investment grade. Moody's Baa1 se situe deux crans au-dessus du plancher (Baa3) : parler de 'juste au-dessus du seuil' pour les deux est inexact. Par ailleurs le meme 10-K indique qu'une troisieme agence, Fitch, a note GPC BBB- avec perspective STABLE au premier trimestre 2026 ; le titre 'perspective negative chez les deux agences' devient trompeur en omettant la troisieme. Rediger : 'perspective negative chez S&P et Moody's fin 2025, S&P au dernier cran investment grade, tandis que Fitch a initie une note BBB- stable au T1 2026'.

controles.affirmation: Le benefice net GAAP recule de 92,7% en 2025 (904 M$ a 66 M$) alors que le CA progresse de 3,5% et la marge brute de 50 points de base a 36,8% ; trois charges : retraite 742 M$, First Brands 150,5 M$, amiante +103 M$ ; EPS ajuste 8,16 a 7,37 (-9,7%) et benefice net ajuste -10,0%
controles.verbatim_source: 'Net income was $66 million in 2025, a decrease of 92.7% compared to $904 million in 2024... Adjusted net income was $1.0 billion in 2025, a decrease of 10.0%... Adjusted diluted EPS was $7.37, down $0.79 compared to $8.16 in 2024.' / 'discrete charges for our pension settlement of $742 million, credit losses from the bankruptcy of First Brands Group of $151 million, and asbestos-related product liability remeasurement of $103 million' (tableau de reconciliation : First Brands credit loss allowance 150,500 K$). / 'Gross margin increased to 36.8% from 36.3% in 2024, a 50 basis point improvement.'

controles.affirmation: Le passif amiante a augmente de 103 M$ en 2025 sous l'effet d'une remeasurement fondee sur une degradation des tendances de reclamations ; produits de friction et de freins vendus principalement avant 1991
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K : 'Adjustment reflects a remeasurement of our asbestos-related product liability for a revised estimate of the number of claims to be incurred in future periods based on adverse current year changes in the claims environment, among other assumptions' ; 'a $103 million increase in our asbestos-related product liability due to adverse trends in claim counts and costs'. 10-Q : 'our distribution and sales of asbestos-containing brake and friction products sold primarily before 1991'.

controles.affirmation: En 2025, la croissance de 3,5% provient de 2,2 points d'acquisitions (plus de 50 operations, plus de 250 sites) et 0,9 point de ventes comparables ; ventes comparables globales a 3,4% au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 'Net sales increased 3.5% in 2025 primarily due to a 2.2% benefit from acquisitions and a 0.9% increase in comparable sales.' / 'In 2025, we completed over 50 strategic acquisitions resulting in over 250 additional locations globally.' / 10-Q : 'For the three months ended June 30, 2026, net sales increased 6.0%... driven by a 3.4% increase in comparable sales'.

controles.affirmation: Scission en deux societes cotees annoncee le 17 fevrier 2026, cible T1 2027, sans garantie de realisation
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : 'On February 17, 2026, we announced our intention to separate the Company into two independent, publicly traded companies: Global Automotive and Global Industrial... The separation is targeted for completion in the first quarter of 2027, subject to certain customary and regulatory conditions. There can be no assurance that any separation transaction will ultimately occur or, if one does occur, of its terms or timing. Our Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements and related footnotes do not reflect the proposed separation.'
